scenes.name: Intro / opening
scenes.notes: 3–5 s intro: logo pops, show name fades in, topic slides up; add intro music or a sting.

scenes.name: Outro (subscribe / CTA)
scenes.notes: Outro / end screen: the video boxes map to YouTube end-screen elements (5–20 s); subscribe button pops, credits can be small.

elements.name: Credits
elements.text:

scenes.name: Transition card: wipe
scenes.notes: Transition hint card (wipe): use as a short stinger, or delete it and apply the same transition to the next scene.

scenes.name: Transition card: fade
scenes.notes: Transition hint card (fade_black): use as a short stinger, or delete it and apply the same transition to the next scene.

scenes.name: Transition card: zoom
scenes.notes: Transition hint card (zoom): use as a short stinger, or delete it and apply the same transition to the next scene.

scenes.name: Chapter title
scenes.notes: Chapter title: number pops, chapter name fades in; the bottom bar shows overall progress.

scenes.name: Quiz
scenes.notes: Quiz: question fades in, options slide in, 5 s countdown, then reveal the answer (answer = correct option).

scenes.name: Comparison (A vs B)
scenes.notes: Comparison: two media side by side (stacked when tall), VS badge pops, pros / cons appear in turn.

elements.name: Title
elements.text: A vs B: which is better?

scenes.name: List / key points
scenes.notes: List: the title appears first, then 3 points slide in about 1.5 s apart, matching the voice-over.

scenes.name: Talking head + lower third
scenes.notes: Talking head: full-frame camera (A-roll); the name strap shows for the first seconds, subtitles follow the voice.

elements.name: Subtitle
elements.text: Subtitles follow the voice line by line

scenes.name: Countdown
scenes.notes: Countdown: the number changes every second (5 → 0), the bar fills in sync; add a tick sound.

scenes.name: Quote
scenes.notes: Quote: quote mark and text fade in, the author appears a moment later; keep it clean, optionally a slow push-in.

elements.name: Text card
elements.text:
A line worth remembering,
right in the middle of the frame.

scenes.name: Product showcase
scenes.notes: Product showcase: product shot (360° video works), name and features appear in turn, price pops, then the buy button.

elements.name: Subheading
elements.text: The main selling point in one line

elements.name: Text card
elements.text:
• Feature one
• Feature two
• Feature three

scenes.name: Credits roll
scenes.notes: Credits roll: the list scrolls from below the frame to above it (scroll_up) over the element's time; the heading stays at the top.
